versions.changelog: P1: rewrite install-conversion summary and standardize legal disclaimer.
v1.1.1: Conversion-optimized SKILL.md with Chinese desc, first-success path, sample prompts
Upgrade to v1.1: add lightweight clause redraft, deeper labor dispute scenarios, pre-litigation decision support, privacy/trust guidance, refreshed templates, tests, and listing copy.
Fix wrong package upload caused by ambiguous publish path; republish correct AI legal assistant content.

- Initial release of ai-legal-assistant-pro.
- Introduces an auto-update skill tool for safely managing OpenClaw skill updates.
- Features version checks, automatic local backups, version rollback, and configurable update strategies.
- Provides command-line tools for skill version checking, backup, update hints, and configuration management.
- Designed with a focus on security: only reads local files and does not perform network requests or execute updates directly.
- All backup and configuration files are stored locally; no sensitive data is collected or transmitted.
